title: Shanghai Launches Major New Policies for the Artificial Intelligence Industry, Signaling a Full-Scale Mobilization for Large Models and Intelligent Global Expansion

content_html:
Recently, the Shanghai Municipal Commerce Commission and six other departments jointly issued the "Shanghai National Service Trade Innovation and Development Demonstration Zone Construction Plan." This significant document clearly states that it will actively layout service trade that synergizes with the artificial intelligence industry, attracting global enterprises and institutions to establish artificial intelligence R&D centers, open-source platforms, and collaborative laboratories in Shanghai, building an open and win-win innovation ecosystem.

In terms of core technologies and products going global, the plan sends a strong policy signal. Shanghai will vigorously promote the expansion of computing power and foundational large models for overseas use, providing solid underlying support for local technology companies to go global. At the same time, the policy explicitly supports the accelerated export of cutting-edge model products such as intelligent agents and multimodal generation, promoting intelligent terminal companies in embodied intelligence to expand new models of full-cycle services, helping Chinese manufacturing and large model technologies establish a solid position in the international market.

In addition to technology and product exports, the deep integration of artificial intelligence with the real economy is also a major focus. The plan proposes comprehensive support for artificial intelligence empowering vertical industries such as healthcare, education, and professional services, accelerating the digital transformation of various industries.

In terms of industrial agglomeration and global governance, Shanghai will continue to hold the World Artificial Intelligence Conference and global developer events, and accelerate the construction of the headquarters of the Global Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization. At the same time, it will fully support Pudong New Area in building an AI innovation application pilot zone, and support Xuhui District in creating the "Model Speed Space" large model innovation ecological community, actively exploring and participating in the construction of the global artificial intelligence governance system.

content_html_zh:
近日，上海市商务委等六部门联合印发《上海国家服务贸易创新发展示范区建设方案》。 这一重要文件明确提出，将积极布局与人工智能产业协同的服务贸易，吸引全球企业和机构在上海设立人工智能研发中心、开源平台、协同实验室，构建开放共赢的创新生态系统。

在核心技术和产品走出去方面，该计划发出了强烈的政策信号。 上海将大力推动算力和基础大模型拓展海外，为本土科技企业走出去提供坚实的底层支撑。 同时，政策明确支持智能代理、多式联运等前沿模型产品加速出口，推动智能终端企业拓展全周期服务新模式，助力中国制造和大模型技术在国际市场上站稳脚跟。

除了技术和产品出口，人工智能与实体经济深度融合也是一大重点。 《规划》提出全面支持人工智能赋能医疗、教育、专业服务等垂直行业，加速各行业数字化转型。

在产业集聚和全球治理方面，上海将继续举办世界人工智能大会和全球开发者活动，加快全球人工智能合作组织总部建设。 同时，全力支持浦东新区建设人工智能创新应用试验区，支持徐汇区打造“模速空间”大型模型创新生态社区，积极探索和参与全球人工智能治理体系建设。
